title: SEG Waiver Node
description: Schema for a Waiver node in the Safety Evidence Graph. Created exclusively by the Functional Safety Manager to excuse a FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED test outcome. Currently sourced from repo G — seg:sourceRepo and seg:sourcePath are retained for future portability if waivers move to a dedicated repo. Append-only and immutable once created. Approver identity and approval timestamp are provenance metadata derived from git log in repo G at proof generation time — not stored in this record.

id.description: Globally unique IRI for this waiver. Form: {namespaceBase}/waiver/WAV-{number}. Maps to spdxId on SPDX export.

type.description: Fixed SEG type. Maps to spdx:Annotation with annotationType review on SPDX export.

name.description: Human-readable waiver identifier. Must match the ID suffix in the id field.

seg:outcomeId.description: IRI reference to the TestOutcome node this waiver excuses. Must resolve to an existing TestOutcome node with outcome FAIL, ERROR, or SKIPPED.

seg:justification.description: Human-readable explanation of why this test outcome is acceptable despite not passing. Should reference supporting evidence such as issue tracker entries, hardware test results, or engineering analysis.

seg:expiry.description: Optional ISO 8601 date after which this waiver is no longer valid. Recommended to force periodic re-examination of known failures.

seg:sourceRepo.description: Source repository for this node. Currently fixed to repoG. Retained for future portability if waivers move to a dedicated repo.

seg:sourcePath.description: Relative path within repo G to the waivers file containing this record.

comment.description: Optional free-text note. Not part of the node content and not included in nodeHash computation.
